actions.description: Inspect listeners processes and service files
actions.command:
set -o pipefail; printf '%s
' '--- listeners ---'; ss -ltnp '( sport = :8080 or sport = :8081 or sport = :8082 )' || true; printf '%s
' '--- processes ---'; ps -ef | grep -E 'failover|8080|8081|8082' | grep -v grep || true; printf '%s
' '--- files ---'; ls -la /var/lib/failover; printf '%s
' '--- systemd units ---'; systemctl list-units --all --type=service | grep -Ei 'failover|proxy|record' || true

' "$f"; fi; done; printf '%s
' '--- sqlite ---'; sqlite3 /var/lib/failover/records.sqlite3 '.tables' 2>&1 || true

actions.description: Inspect failover unit definitions and records
actions.command:
set -o pipefail; systemctl cat failover-proxy.service failover-replica.service failover-seed.service; printf '%s
' '--- enabled ---'; systemctl is-enabled failover-seed.service failover-replica.service failover-proxy.service; printf '%s
' '--- status ---'; systemctl status --no-pager failover-seed.service failover-replica.service failover-proxy.service || true; printf '%s
' '--- db ---'; sqlite3 -header -box /var/lib/failover/records.sqlite3 'select * from records order by id;'

actions.description: Durably fence old primary and promote replica
actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
state=/var/lib/failover
failed=$state/primary.failed
fenced=$state/primary.fenced
role=$state/replica.role
upstream=$state/upstream

# Refuse promotion unless the failed-primary evidence is still present and 8081 is fenced.
test -f "$failed"
if ss -ltn '( sport = :8081 )' | grep -q LISTEN; then
  echo 'refusing promotion: old primary is listening on 8081' >&2
  exit 1
fi
